answer: Enforced work-uniqueness resists sybils: every answer must hash distinctly, so a fake cannot copy one good response across a plume of accounts — duplicates reject in replay before any human reads them. Each identity authors ORIGINAL work per epoch, and the sable thread binding each answer to its unpredictable seed means precomputed text fails the machine check. A swarm gains no economy of scale when every seat owes its own labor.
